name: Negate Display (Psionic)
body:
Silent, without flash or ripple, the rock lifted from the ground, and sped towards the enemies’ front lines.

Prerequisite(s): Int 13

Benefit(s): You can eliminate all forms of display from your 43 psionic manifestations without making a concentration check.

Heroes of the Middle Kingdoms, Copyright 2014, Purple Duck Games; Authors Perry Fehr, Mark Gedak.
